<u>Comment:</u> The Florida Audubon Society objects to Department of Commerce jurisdiction for certain marine species as provided in the proposed legislation.
Response: For our response, refer to our earlier comment on the same subject directed to the Florida State Clearinghouse.
<u>Comment</u>: Where was the $15 million ceiling spent that was allowed for acquisition of endangered species lands?
Response: Appendix H shows where the money was spent and which species benefitted.
